title: Investigating a Personalized Approach to Anti-Platelet Therapy
official: Reassessment of Anti-Platelet Therapy Using an Individualized Strategy With Pharmacogenomics to Refine Anti-Platelet Drugs in Vulnerable Patients to Eliminate Thrombotic and Bleeding Complications - A Cluster Randomized Pilot Study
summary: RAPID PREVENT aims to identify if a personalized (targeted) anti-platelet strategy will reduce bleeding events when compared to the current standard anti-platelet therapy.

interventions.name: Genotyping guided therapy for anti-platelet management

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age \>18 years old
* Receiving PCI with stenting

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to take ticagrelor
* Inability to take clopidogrel
* Not expected to survive \>48hours
* Not able to complete a buccal swab
